workerResult.summary: Ember Atlas — a cyberpunk cooling heat map for charting a week on a 7x24 grid. Paint heat with IGNITE/DOUSE drag brushes; every ignition cools on a real clock (MOLTEN<3h > FIRE 3-9h > EMBER 9-26h > ASH), emitting ember particles and cooling pulses as levels drop. Each cell shows its projected cool-down trail on hover, plus day/hour readout and ignition count. Atlas Read stats (embers, burning %, peak day, cells cooling soon) update live. Persists per-week in localStorage. Ember Export renders a pixel-precise PNG snapshot plus a copyable ASCII ember shard of the whole grid. All sounds synthesized live via WebAudio (ignite plucks pitch with hour, douse/cool whooshes, export chord) with a mute toggle. Palette is exactly 3 colors (cyan, magenta, ember) + black/white. Iteration fixes: corrected particle coordinate system (viewport vs canvas-local offset), added findCellAt fallback for off-screen cell ignition during drag. Verified in-browser at 1440px and 375px with zero console errors and no horizontal overflow.
